title: NullPointerException in BroadcastExchangeExec when relation is empty
description: Spark SQL query crashes with NullPointerException during broadcast join execution if the build-side dataset is empty or partition yields null relation iterator.
error_message: java.lang.NullPointerException: null value encountered in BroadcastExchangeExec relation mapping
comments: Fixed by adding empty relation guard in BroadcastExchangeExec.doExecuteBroadcast before calling broadcast relation construction.

title: SocketTimeoutException leading to consumer group rebalance storm during heavy repartitioning
description: Kafka consumer fails heartbeat when poll processing takes longer than max.poll.interval.ms, causing recurring coordinator rebalances and high CPU usage.
error_message: org.apache.kafka.common.errors.TimeoutException: Failed to send request within 30000 ms.
comments: Decoupled heartbeat thread from user poll thread in KafkaConsumer client to isolate background heartbeats from long-running record processing.

title: ConcurrentModificationException in LRUMap when accessed concurrently without external synchronization
description: Apache Commons Collections LRUMap throws ConcurrentModificationException during get() operations because access order re-linking modifies linked list pointers while iterating.
comments: Resolved by providing thread-safe wrapper Collections.synchronizedMap(new LRUMap(...)) or recommending PassiveExpiringMap.

title: FileNotFoundException in S3AFileSystem due to eventual consistency during rename operations
description: MapReduce job fails on AWS S3 with FileNotFoundException when output committer attempts to rename temporary task directory before S3 metadata has propagated globally.
stack_trace:
java.io.FileNotFoundException: No such file or directory: s3a://prod-data/output/_temporary/task_001
	at org.apache.hadoop.fs.s3a.S3AFileSystem.innerListStatus(S3AFileSystem.java:2088)
	at org.apache.hadoop.fs.s3a.S3AFileSystem.listStatus(S3AFileSystem.java:2057)
	at org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.lib.output.FileOutputCommitter.commitJob(FileOutputCommitter.java:330)
error_message: java.io.FileNotFoundException: S3 key does not exist
comments: Fixed by implementing S3Guard with DynamoDB metadata catalog to guarantee read-after-write consistency.

title: ConnectionPoolTimeoutException: Timeout waiting for connection from pool under heavy concurrent load
description: PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager exhausts available leased connections when HTTP responses with unbuffered streaming entities are not explicitly closed.
stack_trace:
org.apache.http.conn.ConnectionPoolTimeoutException: Timeout waiting for connection from pool
	at org.apache.http.impl.conn.PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager.leaseConnection(PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager.java:316)
	at org.apache.http.impl.execchain.MainClientExec.execute(MainClientExec.java:172)
error_message: org.apache.http.conn.ConnectionPoolTimeoutException: Timeout waiting for connection from pool
comments: Ensure EntityUtils.consume(entity) or try-with-resources on CloseableHttpResponse is utilized to return lease back to pool.
